CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

2. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

4. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   B. Damage equipment used for Photography.
   C. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Photography.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

6. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   C. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.

7. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.

8. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   B. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

9. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Damage equipment used for Songs.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

11. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
